transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Well, thank you for seeing me, Doctor. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. I'm... I guess I'm here because things have gotten a little difficult at work. I drive the industrial trucks down at the warehouse, and, well... I really don't want you to think badly of me, or think I'm making a fuss, but... 

It's the routing system we use. It's... it's not just a normal computer to me anymore. I know how that sounds, I really do, but I've noticed it's been marking my moves. It's like it's sending these messages through the scanners to try and push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands there. 

Does that make sense? I hope it's okay that I brought that up... I just didn't know who else to talk to about it without sounding foolish.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Well... I, um... I really don't want you to think I'm crazy or anything. I know it sounds bad. But... yes, I guess I have been. 

It's, well, it's the dispatch voices. Even when I'm at home, you know, just sitting in my garage trying to relax, with the radio off and everything completely quiet... I can hear them. Clear as day. They call out my operator number, and they say... they say I'm dangerous, or that security is on their way to come get me. 

I know it's probably just stress, right? Just my mind playing tricks on me because I'm so worried about my job? I hope I'm not making too big a deal out of it. Is it normal to get a little overwhelmed like that sometimes?
When you hear these dispatch voices, do they ever talk to each other about you?

Um, well, like I was just saying... and I'm sorry, I hope I'm not repeating myself too much, I just want to make sure I'm answering you right. 

When I'm out in the garage, you know, when everything is shut off and quiet... it's mostly just them calling out my operator number. Sometimes it sounds like one dispatch voice saying I'm dangerous, and maybe another one chiming in that security is coming for me... so I guess, in a way, they might be talking to each other over the radio? But it's mostly just those alerts I mentioned before. 

I really hope that's helpful. Am I explaining it okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

Oh, um... unusually energetic? No, I don't think so. I really don't want to give you the wrong impression, but honestly, it's usually the opposite for me. I've been feeling pretty worn down lately, to be honest. 

I definitely haven't had any times where I didn't need sleep, or felt super energized. I hope that's the right answer? I just try to get my rest when I can, even if it's hard with... well, with everything going on. Is it okay that I haven't experienced that? I just want to be sure I'm giving you the full picture.
Before these voices and messages started, had you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness?

No, no, nothing like that. I... I've always tried to take good care of my health, you know? I go to my checkups when I'm supposed to, and my doctor back home always said I was doing just fine for my age. 

I don't have any brain problems or... or major medical issues, I promise. Just the usual aches and pains from driving the forklift all these years. I really hope that's a good thing? I mean, I know this all sounds like a lot, but physically, I've always been pretty healthy. Does that help rule some things out for you?
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Well, I wouldn't say *depressed*, exactly. I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm complaining or anything. I know everybody gets a little down sometimes, right? 

I guess I have been feeling a bit... tired, maybe? Just kind of low on energy lately. But I still try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I don't want to be a burden on anyone. I really try to just push through it and focus on doing my job. 

Is it normal to feel a little worn out like that at my age? I just want to make sure I'm not making a big deal out of nothing. I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have other people told you that your speech or behavior has seemed disorganized or hard to follow?

Well, um... I wouldn't say disorganized, exactly. I really don't want you to think I'm losing my mind or anything. I try really hard to keep things together. But... I guess there have been a few times where people pointed out I was acting a little, um, mixed up? 

I'm almost embarrassed to say it, but sometimes at work, and even at home, I just sort of... get stuck. I'll be standing there, and I'll have my hands up in the air like they're still right there on the forklift controls. And I guess I start repeating the same safety phrase over and over again, even when folks are standing right in front of me trying to talk to me. 

I think it's just because I want to be so careful on the job, you know? Just a safety habit that gets a little carried away. I hope that doesn't sound too strange? I'm really trying to be helpful and give you the right answers. Is it okay that I do that sometimes?
About how long have the voices and the feeling that the routing system is sending you messages been going on?

Well, um... I guess it's been a little while now. I really hope I haven't let it go on too long without saying anything. I just kept thinking it would pass, you know? 

If I really sit down and think about it, the voices and... and the things with the routing scanners... it's probably been about a year and eight months? Give or take a little bit. 

I know that sounds like a long time to be dealing with something like this. I really tried to just manage it on my own so I wouldn't bother anybody or make a fuss at the warehouse. I hope you don't think poorly of me for waiting so long to get help. I'm doing the right thing by telling you now, aren't I?
